title: Only ONE Person Knows My Name 🔢
description:
Only one person in this whole town knows my name. The number over every head counts the people who know your name, and mine has said one for years.

This spring my little brother's number started falling, and in the old reading room something with no number at all sat one table nearer to him every afternoon.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment ONE if you already know who your one would be.
